script: Chapter 7. On-Page SEO and Content Optimisation. A well-optimised page has one H1, clear H2 sections, images with alt text, and a clear call to action. The answer comes early. Write titles in the pattern: topic, benefit, then brand. Use a content brief to tell the writer the keyword, the intent, the outline, and the links. Practice: rewrite the title and H1 of one page, then add three internal links. Recap: clear titles, helpful content, and a next step.
glossary: on-page SEO, H1, H2, alt text, content brief, internal link
